Museum Samples Aid Major Genetic Revision of Bat Family Tree

The Royal Ontario Museum supplied genetic samples that were incorporated into a large-scale genetic analysis, leading researchers to revise the evolutionary family tree of bats, according to reports from multiple news outlets.
